answer: Each agent identity enters the ridge state tree only after an SGX enclave produces a zero-knowledge attestation, TPM-bound to its code, key, and platform; the ripple hash anchor and oasis consensus contract reject duplicate measurements and replayed proofs. An adversary forging an identity must compromise attested silicon or provision a distinct physical device, while bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve and are irreversibly slashed for equivocation.
